parts.title: Projector Resolved Seed Calculus I
parts.subtitle: Typed operator systems, seed rank, and exact packet coordinates
parts.description: Seeds, operators and projectors provide the linear language of the series. Exact packet coordinates make the generated objects and the maps between them visible.
parts.boundary: The correspondence concerns the stated proof-level constructions. Noncomputable existence results do not provide executable solvers.

parts.title: Projector Resolved Seed Calculus II
parts.subtitle: Refinement towers, weighted transfer, and integral separation of operator packets
parts.description: Refinement towers compare packet descriptions across levels. Weighted transfers and integral separation show which structures survive a change of resolution.
parts.boundary: Canonical values are defined for admissible data. A general existence theorem for admissible contours remains a separate question.

parts.title: Projector Resolved Seed Calculus III
parts.subtitle: Typed transfer, nonlinear packets, and obstruction theory
parts.description: Typed operations extend the linear language to nonlinear coordinates, analytic packet jets and obstruction theory. The analytic supplement develops the continuous packet-jet claims.
parts.boundary: Expanded ordinary proofs and the bounded Lean core have different coverage. The packet Taylor estimates, counting arguments and later extensions retain their stated ordinary-proof status. Arbitrary differentiability is not asserted.

parts.title: Multiresolution Signal Calculus
parts.subtitle: Exact coordinates, singular packets, and stable reconstruction
parts.description: Signal models move through filters, packet trees and reconstruction maps. Exact coordinates and singular packets distinguish representation from approximation and recovery.
parts.boundary: Separated-jump results require the stated model, gap and grid assumptions. Stable edge-packet recovery and the broader approximation class remain open.

parts.title: Transfer Semigroups and Memory
parts.subtitle: Probabilistic refinement, fractional operators, and exact hidden-state elimination
parts.description: Evolution, probability and conditioning share a transfer language. Eliminating hidden states produces memory terms whose hypotheses remain part of the model.
parts.boundary: Finite-state, common-gap and fixed-partition restrictions remain explicit. Completion, uniform refinement control and stable infinite latent-packet closure remain open. Floating residuals are not interval certificates.

parts.title: Quantum Seeds and Effective Dynamics
parts.subtitle: Symmetry, geometric transport, quantum channels, and bounded refinement towers
parts.description: Quantum seeds generate spaces through an operator grammar. Symmetry, circuits, geometric transport and quantum channels lead to finite effective dynamics and bounded refinement questions.
parts.boundary: The finite formal contract does not certify the full continuum physics program. Anomaly-free refinement, uniform Feshbach control, Lorentzian reconstruction and the proposed gravitational limits remain open.

parts.title: Packet Operator Algorithms
parts.subtitle: Exact compilation and GPU realization
parts.description: Structured packet representations remove work before execution. Exact compilation connects algebraic structure, recompression, precision and stated hardware observations.
parts.boundary: Small-core optimality uses supplied ordered thin-SVD equations and actual compact ranges. General numerical SVD verification, unrestricted discovery and CUDA-kernel verification require further results.

parts.title: Euler Congruences
parts.subtitle: Completion, factorial strengthening, and sharp dyadic geometry
parts.description: Euler congruences are developed through completion, factorial strengthening and dyadic geometry. The accompanying guides connect exact statements, bounded examples and formal coverage.
parts.boundary: The arithmetic, dyadic and lifting results have distinct hypotheses. General Euler-tail simplicity and the broader native and polyphase extensions remain open.
